subject: math

objective.text: Add measurements with the standard algorithm. Rename 10 ones as 1 ten when you need to.

explanations.title: Add with place value disks
explanations.text: Show 56 and 27 with disks. 6 ones plus 7 ones is 13 ones. Change 10 ones for 1 ten.

explanations.title: The standard algorithm
explanations.text: Write the numbers in columns. Add the ones. If you get 10 or more, rename them as a ten and write it in the tens column.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (renaming in the algorithm is the same as changing with disks)

explanations.title: Mental math can be quicker
explanations.text: For 39 plus 8, add 1 to make 40, then add 7 more. 39 plus 8 equals 47.

explanations.title: Keep the unit
explanations.text: 56 milliliters plus 27 milliliters equals 83 milliliters. Always say the unit in the answer.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (What unit do we need to include?)

examples.title: 56 mL plus 27 mL
examples.text: Ones: 6 plus 7 is 13. Write 3, rename 1 ten. Tens: 5 plus 2 plus 1 is 8. Answer: 83 milliliters.

examples.title: 46 mL plus 5 mL
examples.text: 46 plus 4 is 50. 50 plus 1 more is 51 milliliters.

questions.text: There are 100 centimeters in 1 meter. How many centimeters are in 8 meters?
45 minutes plus how many minutes equals 1 hour?
1 kilogram minus 650 grams equals how many grams?

source_ref.section: Fluency: Round Three- and Four-Digit Numbers (1,678)

questions.text: Use mental math. What is 125 grams plus 7 grams?
Beaker A has 56 milliliters. Beaker B has 27 milliliters. What is 6 ones plus 7 ones?
56 milliliters plus 27 milliliters. What is the total?
Marcus erases 32 centimeters from Lisa's line. Now it is 187 centimeters. How long was Lisa's line?
John reads 74 minutes on Wednesday. On Thursday he reads 17 minutes more. How many minutes in total?
46 milliliters plus 25 milliliters equals what number?
509 centimeters plus 83 centimeters equals what number?
480 grams plus 476 grams equals what number?
1 liter 245 milliliters plus 2 liters 412 milliliters. What is the total?
Greg mows the front lawn in 15 minutes. The back takes 17 minutes more. How long does he mow in total?
345 kilometers plus 239 kilometers equals what number?
Jen drinks apple juice (125 milliliters) and water (248 milliliters). How much does she drink?
When would you use mental math instead of the standard algorithm?

hints.text: Start with the ones. Add the ones column first.
Do you have 10 or more ones? Rename 10 ones as 1 ten.
Make the next ten first, then add what is left.
Draw a tape diagram. Find the unknown part first if there are two steps.
Think of the whole: 1 hour is 60 minutes, 1 liter is 1,000 milliliters.
Find the two tens or hundreds on each side. Is it past halfway?
